# Preprocessing and coverage report (generated by src/data/coverage_report.py)

## Final hourly dataset
- Hourly grid: 38,520 hours per building (2013-08-10 00:00 to 2017-12-31 23:00 IST) x 7 buildings = 269,640 rows, 25 columns in `data/processed/hourly_features.csv.gz`.
- Target: `power_w` = hourly mean of valid one-minute `power` readings, in W (unit confirmed in the I-BLEND Data Descriptor). Valid hour: at least 45 of 60 readings.
- Primary model matrix: 156,332 rows x 14 features (rows with an observed target and all features available). Energy-only ablation rows: 223,130.
- Primary features: hour, dayofweek, is_weekend, month, working_day, activity_high, power_lag1, power_lag2, power_lag24, power_roll_mean_24, power_roll_std_24, occ_lag1, occ_lag2, occ_lag24.

## Gap handling
Targets are never filled. For lag/rolling inputs only, a causal last-observation-carried-forward is allowed for at most 1 h. Rule: the largest k <= 6 h for which carrying the last value beats the value from 24 h earlier in all seven buildings (masking experiment, 3,000 samples per building and k). Result: recommended 1 h; configured 1 h. Linear interpolation was more accurate in the experiment but uses the value after the gap, so it would leak the target and is not used for features.

## Chronological split (global dates, chosen by a fixed rule from eligible-row counts)
- Rule: among month-boundary candidates with pooled shares in (0.55, 0.75)/(0.1, 0.2)/(0.1, 0.25), maximise the smallest per-building min(validation rows, test rows).
- Train: before 2016-07-01; validation: 2016-07-01 to before 2017-01-01; test: 2017-01-01 onward (until the last hour with occupancy lags, 2017-11-04 00:00).
- Pooled shares: {'train': 0.58, 'val': 0.182, 'test': 0.238}.
